messages.subject: stat_vline error?
parts:
I'm new to ggplot so perhaps I'm doing something wrong, but after I
successfully plot some data, leaving me with an instance "gplt" of the
ggplot class, I then tried:

> gplt+ stat_vline(mapping=NULL, data=NULL, geom="vline", position="identity", intercept=2)
Error in get("calculate", env = ., inherits = TRUE)(., ...) :
stat_vline now uses xintercept instead of intercept

After receiving this error message which suggests using xintercept
(although the help mentions only 'intercept'), I tried:

> gplt+ stat_vline(mapping=NULL, data=NULL, geom="vline", position="identity", xintercept=2)
Error in do.call("layer", list(mapping = mapping, data = data, geom =
geom, :
argument "intercept" is missing, with no default

Which seems to contradict the previous error message. I later managed
to break out of the infinite loop of trying xintercept, and then
intercept, and so on :)
Then I tried both intercept and xintercept:

>gplt+ stat_vline(mapping=NULL, data=NULL, geom="vline", position="identity",intercept=3, xintercept=2)
Error in get("calculate", env = ., inherits = TRUE)(., ...) :
stat_vline now uses xintercept instead of intercept

Am I doing something wrong?

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: stat_vline error?
parts:
> After receiving this error message which suggests using xintercept
> (although the help mentions only 'intercept'), I tried:
>
>> gplt+ stat_vline(mapping=NULL, data=NULL, geom="vline", position="identity", xintercept=2)
> Error in do.call("layer", list(mapping = mapping, data = data, geom =
> geom,  :
>  argument "intercept" is missing, with no default

Why are you setting mapping and data to NULL? And you should be using
geom_vline, not stat_vline.
The following should work:

gplt + geom_vline(xintercept=2)

If it doesn't, please send a small reproducible example.

Hadley
